brief:
Britain's foreign minister committed to strengthening the UK's stance on Israeli actions in Gaza and the West Bank, Al Jazeera English reported. The official vowed to "match word with action" in defending Palestinian rights, signaling a shift toward more robust policy measures.

The pledge comes amid mounting international scrutiny of Israeli military operations and settlement expansion. Details of specific measures or timelines for implementation remain unclear.
dek: British foreign minister vows to 'match word with action' when it comes to defending Palestinian rights.
title: Britain pledges tougher response to Israeli actions in Palestinian territories
